newsitem.title: USA: Playtex files suit against Gerber Products.
newsitem.headline: Playtex files suit against Gerber Products.

text.p: Playtex Products Inc said on Wednesday that it had filed suit in New York district court against Gerber Products Co in an attempt to stop the company from running an advertisement for its "Easy Sip, Spill Proof Cup."

A spokesman for Playtex told Reuters that the print ad, which has appeared in consumer magazines, features a picture of a baby unable to drink from a spill-proof cup and implies the cup is a Playtex product.
"We found through research that mothers believe that fluid does not come out of our valve," spokesman Martin Petersen said.
In addition, the suit alleges that Gerber makes an unfair claim in the ad when it says its cup is 50 percent easier to use than the leading product, Petersen said.
No one was immediately available at Gerber Products to comment on the allegations.
Gerber is a unit of Swiss drug and nutrition company Novartis AG.
